message.monitoringcenter_auditor.not_own: This Auditor belongs to another team.
screen.monitoringcenter_auditor.title: Auditor
screen.monitoringcenter_auditor.help: Measures how many items per minute go through the block.
screen.monitoringcenter_auditor.toleranc: Ends the measurement early after this many ticks without items. 0 turns it off.
screen.monitoringcenter_auditor.limit.he: Most items per tick; the excess is refused. 0 turns it off.
screen.monitoringcenter_auditor.invalid: A field is outside its allowed range.
screen.monitoringcenter_auditor.io.help: Left/right click switches a face between Input, Output and Off.
message.monitoringcenter_auditor.certifi: Certification started with the item in your hand.
Hold the item to certify and use Consume mode.
Certification passed: %s, %s seal. The seal is in the Auditor tray.
Certification failed: %s, %s seal, below the goal in minute %s.
message.monitoringcenter_auditor.not_you: This seal belongs to another team.
message.monitoringcenter_auditor.certifi: Certification cancelled: %s, %s seal. The Auditor left Consume mode.
A certification is already running on this Auditor.
screen.monitoringcenter_auditor.board.no: No item has gone through this Auditor yet.
screen.monitoringcenter_auditor.board.em: Nobody has certified this item yet.
message.monitoringcenter_auditor.monopol: %s holds five records and became a Monopolist!
message.monitoringcenter_auditor.milesto: %s-seal milestone: %s is in the Auditor tray.
tooltip.monitoringcenter_auditor.seal.ex: Of Excellence: on a Plaque, +2 radius and +10% energy saving
item.monitoringcenter_auditor.junior_dip: Second chance: forgives one minute below the goal per certification
item.monitoringcenter_auditor.master_dip: Seal of excellence: your seals come out Of Excellence (stronger Plaque)
tooltip.monitoringcenter_auditor.diploma: Works in your inventory or charm slot. Shows next to your name.
The trophy inspires the team again in %s min.
%s raised the Bronze Trophy: Haste for 5 minutes!
%s raised the Gold Trophy: Haste II and Speed for 5 minutes!
hologram.monitoringcenter_auditor.title: Team record
screen.monitoringcenter_auditor.mode: What to do with the items
screen.monitoringcenter_auditor.mode.pas: Items come in through the Input, are counted and leave through the Outputs.
screen.monitoringcenter_auditor.mode.con: Items are counted and destroyed. This is the mode for certifying.
screen.monitoringcenter_auditor.reason.n: no face is an Input (open Faces…)
no face is an Output (open Faces…)
screen.monitoringcenter_auditor.reason.o: the Output does not touch any inventory
screen.monitoringcenter_auditor.faces.he: Each square is a side of the block, showing the block next to it.
screen.monitoringcenter_auditor.faces.fr: Front: it is the display, it takes and gives no items.
screen.monitoringcenter_auditor.advanced: Only change these if the rate jumps around too much.
Instant shows each measurement; Smoothed averages it with the previous one.
Interval: ticks per measurement (20 = 1 s). Tolerance: ends a measurement early after this many ticks without items. Limit: most items per tick (0 = no limit).
Goal: %s items per minute, for %s min
Goal: reopen the Auditor holding the item to see it
No diplomas: earn seals to get them
screen.monitoringcenter_auditor.run.forg: Bad minutes that can still be forgiven: %s
screen.monitoringcenter_auditor.run.tip: Keep production above the goal every minute. Leaving Consume mode cancels the certification.
